status: Both source pilots reviewed; 240 development Train inputs and recipes frozen. 24 evaluations complete; optional seed stability in progress. Fresh final Test absent.
research_question: Which local adaptation gives the best DE/EN full-article outcome classification under the declared quality/latency/size rule? Japanese is a conditional extension.

primary_metric.name: mean_de_en_macro_f1
primary_metric.development: Concatenate each candidate's out-of-fold predictions, calculate 3-class macro-F1 separately per language, then average DE and EN. Report fold SD separately.
primary_metric.japanese: Separate per-language result; equal three-language mean is secondary and never replaces the DE/EN primary metric after observing results.

pilot.role: development only, never a fresh final test
pilot.annotation: Assistant reads exact full input; two documented self-review passes without candidate predictions. Same annotator, not independent verification.
gates: revision-specific source rights and third-party passage review
native text and adequate class/topic/length coverage
measured annotation time and tokenizer lengths
pilot.japanese_failure: Document missing rights, supply or coverage; continue mandatory DE/EN without silently switching to translated test text.
pilot.first_checkpoint_result: checkpoint-90.json: 90 two-pass AI labels, 35 rights-eligible; no eligible English positive inputs; 1 unresolved reference label. Preserve exact reviewed v3 inputs.

second_checkpoint_frame.excludes: All 90 development-exposed v3 pages, prior collected historical pages, observed protected keys, explicit translations, pre-2005-09-26 pages, long direct quotations >=80 chars DE/EN or >=40 JA. Manual rights review still mandatory.
second_checkpoint_frame.scope: Frozen recent-1500 published-category frame/language; quote-length condition is class-blind but changes population. No sentiment predictions or labels for eligibility.

pilot.second_checkpoint_result: 300 v4 inputs read twice; 25 unresolved rights, 1 unresolved reference. V5 exact-hash transfer plus five changed texts re-read twice. After conservative observed source/translation/event protection, 240 Train inputs remain.

data.expansion_6000: Deferred; requires a new justified protocol decision based on development evidence and annotation cost.
data.final_test_sampling: Native articles; group-disjoint, representative declared source/time/topic population. No score-based removals or seed changes to improve class balance. Report scarce classes and uncertainty.
data.split: Reviewed article/event/translation/source groups, then language:label stratification where feasible. Grouped 3-fold CV inside Train only. Original Val and historical tests/related groups remain protected.
data.legacy_leads: Full articles require new annotations. No automatic inheritance of old lead labels; no initialization from restricted legacy fine-tunes.
data.rights: Source text, annotation metadata, code and model licences are separate. No academically restricted legacy corpora in the publication-oriented pool.
data.difficulty: Keep difficult valid inputs. Neutral is not uncertainty. Log unreadable/rights exclusions and unresolvable labels separately, including coverage.
data.selected_train_scope: 78 DE, 71 EN, 91 JA. Complete suitable second-pilot pool; not evidence of an optimal or sufficient quantity. The measured nested MiniLM learning curve has not saturated.

quantity.control: Same dev inputs; freeze source/class allocation; log tokens and optimizer steps, not just rows.

one_additional_question.choose_before_execution: Context/aggregation OR fixed-count selection OR another evidence-backed question; do not mix them into an uninterpretable bundle.
one_additional_question.chosen: MiniLM chunk windows 256 and 512 against the 128-token core control, all with identical mean chunk-feature article pooling and article-level loss; six additional evaluations.

stability_if_needed.execution: Triggered by a .01105 top-two OOF gap. One additional LoRA seed across three folds; reuse deterministic zero-shot outputs without a meaningless changed-training-seed repeat.

experiments.development_limit: 24 to 30 scored evaluations; training fits, engineering checks and final-test evaluations counted separately.
experiments.final_candidates: 4, at most 5; fixed before final inference; full-Train fits for all trainable candidates; final test once per candidate.
experiments.transfer: Separate deferred study, initially one family. Source-only tuning; no target labels for examples, stopping or hyperparameters. Prior target-pilot exposure disclosed. Equal training count/class controls for leave-one-language-out and three-language reference.

sampling population, exclusions and group membership
latency: Same tower, isolated worker, warmups separate, batch one, synchronized CUDA. Tokenization/transfers/context included; loading and URL fetch excluded and reported separately. No repeated Test inference for timing.
technical: second-path only; no merge from or changes on main
